title: Control-room shell frame and J1 board slice
description: Task B of the control-room shell pre-split (architect-d89636d1; honest combined file map was 18-20 vs the caps — split before code exists per the size-governance memories). Objective: the shell FRAME plus the minimal operable J1 slice over the Task-A scaffold. Deliverable, using the verification findings pinned here (do not rediscover): src/shell/ = frame ONLY (nav rail + main outlet + inspector + status strip per spec line 51; the BOARD is a surface, spec §2.2) + provenance drill-down panel consuming the shell-local DEVELOPMENT_ONLY provenance fixture type (spec §3.2 popover shape: event seq+ID, actor/session, lease epoch, timestamp, typed link — no repo-wide provenance type exists; follow the testkit FOUNDATION_FAKE_KIND marker pattern); minimal J1 slices placed in the CANONICAL DOWNSTREAM DIRECTORIES (spec §6.1 lines 499-509: goals form 503; board columns cr.board.column.* with name/phase/chip cards, NO joinstrip/silence-timer/terminated-filter; approval detail with cr.action.approval-decide.approve for plan+acceptance kinds; node inspector chipped facts only, no §10.5 attempt detail; evidence receipt exit-0 + base/head SHAs; doctor = cr.health.status summary only) — the five downstream surface tasks own those dirs and BUILD OVER these slices, never duplicate them (the rejected alternative was src/surfaces/ stubs that become undeletable dead duplicates). ACTION-GATING SEMANTICS (spec-verified, the earlier draft was WRONG): disconnected fixture => ALL cr.action.* DISABLED (not hidden) + banner (spec 524/530, role=status/alert per 687); LAG/STALE fixture => stale display LABELED, commands NOT blocked (spec 614, CR-LAG-001 739); daemon-reason-coded-disabled is a SEPARATE provisional DEVELOPMENT_ONLY fixture channel (NextAllowedCommand carries no reason field; §13-D2 registry unratified — no daemon reason => control ABSENT, never disabled-with-guessed-text, spec 588-590); actions render ONLY from supplied readonly NextAllowedCommand[] (@moe/contracts buildNextAllowedCommands/EMPTY_NEXT_ALLOWED_COMMANDS). Graph tab renders as a NON-MOUNTING placeholder and a test asserts cr.graph.* is NEVER mounted during the J1 flow (spec 509/CR-J1-002 722). Triple encoding comes from the Task-A kernel adapter (describeTruthClass re-export with the absent-class→UNKNOWN mapping); every cr.fact.* has a cr.chip.* descendant (spec 742 bar 3), 24px hit target + aria-label composition + UNKNOWN dashed border (spec 176). Keyboard/a11y for THIS task: jsdom-testable roles/labels/focus-order/keyboard basics via @testing-library (spec 684/687/691 — Enter/p provenance); NO axe dep; WCAG/monochrome/latency + Playwright journeys belong to Accessibility latency hardening and Control-room journey gate. FIXTURE CONTENT TRIPWIRE: no fixture string may contain 'packages/scheduler/src/' or '@moe/scheduler/' or 'scheduler/src/' literals (scheduler package-boundary test scans apps/** .tsx CONTENTS at the root gate) and no fixture module imports a path containing 'foundation/' (testkit foundation-spec scans apps/** .ts import specifiers). Named import { userEvent } (default-import fails tsc under NodeNext — proven). Hard dependency: Task A (Foundation control-room shell, task-fd82678f) — scaffold, kernel adapter, fixtures, and the frontend dependency set must be landed first; block if absent. Owned paths: apps/control-room/src/shell/**, apps/control-room/src/board/**, apps/control-room/src/goals/**, apps/control-room/src/approvals/**, apps/control-room/src/nodes/**, apps/control-room/src/evidence/**, apps/control-room/src/doctor/**, and app-level test files for these slices. Keep total files <=10 (merge tests: one gating+keyboard test, one board/J1 flow test) and every file <=250 lines. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test.
definitionOfDone: The shell frame renders nav/outlet/inspector/status-strip with the Graph tab as a never-mounted placeholder, proven by a test asserting no cr.graph.* mounts during the J1 flow.

The J1 slice is operable end-to-end on fixtures: goals form, board columns with chip cards, approval decide action, node inspector chipped facts, evidence receipt line, doctor status summary — each in its canonical downstream directory.

Action gating matches the spec exactly: disconnected disables all actions with a banner; lag labels stale without blocking; absent daemon reason renders no control; actions derive only from supplied NextAllowedCommand[].
Keyboard reachability, roles/labels, and provenance drill-down (Enter/p) pass jsdom tests; the focused control-room typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Frame-and-slice only: the five downstream surface tasks own the full surfaces and build over the J1 slices in place — do not pre-build their scope and do not create src/surfaces/, src/a11y/, or src/performance/.
Never mutate from the client: no client-derived authority; disabled/absent semantics per spec 524/530/588-590/614; no guessed disabled-reason text.
Fixture strings must never contain scheduler path literals; fixture modules must never import 'foundation/' paths.
Every file <=250 lines; <=10 files total; explicit-pathspec commit only.

implementationPlan.description: Baseline + COLLISION GATE (governor watch): Task A (task-fd82678f) is at 4/5 and still owns the shared entry files — this task NEVER touches apps/control-room/src/main.tsx, src/kernel.tsx, src/fixtures.ts, package.json, tsconfig.json, vite.config.ts, index.html, or pnpm-lock.yaml. The frame is wired for the DoD via TESTS (jsdom renders ShellFrame directly); the one-line main.tsx mount of the frame is deferred to a follow-up after A closes (record in the completion note for the governor — do NOT edit main.tsx even if A finishes mid-task). Verify A's artifacts present: src/kernel.tsx (TruthChip + describeTruthClass re-export + absent->UNKNOWN mapping), src/fixtures.ts (J1 snapshots + three affordance states + provenance fixture type + DEVELOPMENT_ONLY markers), dependency set installed. If kernel/fixtures exports differ from the description's assumptions, adapt consumption — never edit A's files; if fundamentally absent, report_blocked needsFrom task-fd82678f. Fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` GREEN baseline. Re-read this task's own description — it pins every spec decision (gating semantics 524/530/588-590/614, J1 slice per surface §6.1, tripwires, never-mounted Graph, canonical downstream dirs); NEW EPIC RAILS also apply: per-file 250 cap (no per-task LOC bar) and assert-the-reason/testid, mutation-red-check failure paths.

TDD red — src/shell/gating-keyboard.test.tsx (<=250; NAMED import { userEvent }). The action-gating matrix (spec-exact, all via Task A fixtures): (1) CONNECTED fixture: actions render ONLY from the supplied readonly NextAllowedCommand[] — for each affordance an enabled control with its cr.action.* testid; EMPTY affordances -> ZERO action controls in the DOM (absent, not disabled); (2) DISCONNECTED fixture: banner with role=status/alert (spec 687) AND every cr.action.* control DISABLED (present, not hidden — spec 524); assert the banner and enabled-action states never coexist (spec 530); (3) LAG/STALE fixture: stale display LABELED (visible stale marker testid) while controls stay ENABLED — commands NOT blocked (spec 614 / CR-LAG-001); (4) REASON-CODED-DISABLED provisional channel: only the separate DEVELOPMENT_ONLY fixture channel may render disabled-with-reason; a fixture affordance WITHOUT a daemon reason renders NO control ever disabled-with-guessed-text (spec 588-590); (5) KEYBOARD: every rendered control reachable in DOM order (tab traversal via userEvent), roles/labels present; provenance drill-down opens via Enter and 'p' (spec 691) showing the §3.2 popover fields from the fixture provenance type; focus returns on close. Each assertion targets the spec testid taxonomy (cr.action.*, cr.chip.*, cr.banner.*). Confirm RED.

Green — src/shell/frame.tsx + src/shell/provenance-panel.tsx (each <=250). frame.tsx: nav rail + main outlet + inspector + status strip ONLY (spec line 51 — the board is a SURFACE, not shell); nav includes the Graph tab as a NON-MOUNTING placeholder (a nav entry that renders no cr.graph.* subtree — spec 509/CR-J1-002); the disconnected banner + gating context provider (affordance state flows down; surfaces consume via context/props — no client-derived authority, actions only from supplied NextAllowedCommand[]); stale-label plumbing per the lag fixture. provenance-panel.tsx: drill-down panel rendering the shell-local DEVELOPMENT_ONLY provenance fixture shape (event seq+ID, actor/session, lease epoch, timestamp, typed link — spec §3.2), opened via chip interaction (Enter/'p'), keyboard-dismissable, focus-restoring. Both consume Task A's kernel TruthChip — never reimplement truth logic. Step-2 tests green.

TDD red then green — the six J1 slices in their CANONICAL DOWNSTREAM DIRECTORIES (each <=250; the five surface tasks BUILD OVER these in place — minimal J1 only, spec §6.1 lines 499-509): src/goals/goals-j1.tsx (goal creation form fields per 503 — fixture-submit only, no network); src/board/board-j1.tsx (five columns cr.board.column.* with name/phase/chip cards — NO joinstrip, NO silence timer, NO terminated filter); src/approvals/approval-j1.tsx (approval detail + cr.action.approval-decide.approve for plan+acceptance kinds from affordances); src/nodes/node-inspector-j1.tsx (chipped facts only — no §10.5 attempt detail); src/evidence/evidence-j1.tsx (receipt exit-0 + base/head SHAs line); src/doctor/doctor-j1.tsx (cr.health.status summary only). Every fact rendered through the kernel TruthChip (cr.fact.* wrapper guarantees a cr.chip.* descendant — spec 742 bar 3; 24px hit target, aria-label, UNKNOWN dashed border via the kernel descriptor). Plus src/shell/j1-flow.test.tsx (<=250): the J1 operable-flow test — render frame + surfaces on the connected fixture, walk goal->board->node->approval->evidence->doctor, assert the three-human-action J1 shape is reachable, AND the never-mounted assertion: no element with a cr.graph.* testid exists at ANY point of the flow (mutation-red-check: temporarily render a cr.graph.* stub locally, watch it fail, revert). FIXTURE TRIPWIRES re-checked: no scheduler path literals in any string, no 'foundation/' import specifiers.

Verification gate. (1) `wc -l apps/control-room/src/shell/*.tsx apps/control-room/src/*/[a-z]*-j1.tsx` — every file <=250 (per-file rail; no per-task bar). (2) Fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test` -> exit 0 — complete_task evidence with that exact command. (3) `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room build` -> exit 0. (4) Collision audit: `git status --porcelain -- apps/control-room` shows ONLY the ten owned Task-B paths — zero edits to A's files (main.tsx/kernel.tsx/fixtures.ts/config); if Task A landed its final step mid-task, re-run the focused gate against the updated tree and attribute. (5) Root gate `pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` (scheduler boundary scan covers the new .tsx contents at root — tripwire check) with foreign-red by-path attribution. (6) Run focused suite twice — identical.

Adversarial self-review + explicit-pathspec commit. Load Skill adversarial-self-review. Red-team: (a) authority hunt — no code path constructs a command envelope or dispatches anything (grep for createCompatGate/dispatch/fetch/XMLHttpRequest/WebSocket -> zero usage; affordances are render-only); (b) gating inversions — disconnected+enabled coexistence impossible (mutation-check: force an enabled action under the banner locally, test red, revert); lag never disables; guessed disabled-text impossible (no string fallback path); (c) never-mounted Graph re-checked after every surface added; (d) keyboard trap hunt — tab cycle through the full frame+surfaces, no focus trap, provenance focus restore; (e) tripwire greps one final time ('scheduler/src', '@moe/scheduler/', foundation-import) -> zero; (f) no scratch files (auto-commit sweep). Commit per epic rail 3: `git status --porcelain`, unstage foreign paths, `git add` + `git commit -- apps/control-room/src/shell/frame.tsx apps/control-room/src/shell/provenance-panel.tsx apps/control-room/src/shell/gating-keyboard.test.tsx apps/control-room/src/shell/j1-flow.test.tsx apps/control-room/src/goals/goals-j1.tsx apps/control-room/src/board/board-j1.tsx apps/control-room/src/approvals/approval-j1.tsx apps/control-room/src/nodes/node-inspector-j1.tsx apps/control-room/src/evidence/evidence-j1.tsx apps/control-room/src/doctor/doctor-j1.tsx`; `git show --stat` lists exactly these 10 paths. Completion note: main.tsx frame-mount is a deferred one-line follow-up owned by the governor's routing (A owned the file through this task's lifetime).

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: This task's description was authored by me during the Task-A pre-split with every spec finding pinned (2-agent workflow: spec-scope + toolchain with scratchpad proofs) — no fresh verification round needed; the plan applies the pinned decisions. New decisions in this plan: (1) COLLISION RESOLUTION (governor watch): the frame is proven via direct jsdom rendering in tests, so main.tsx (owned by in-flight Task A) is never edited; the one-line mount is a deferred follow-up — keeps the two tasks file-disjoint through A's final step. (2) Test placement in src/shell/ (owned) rather than app root — keeps the 10-path commit clean. (3) Six slice files named *-j1.tsx inside the canonical downstream dirs so the surface tasks extend beside them without rename churn. Rejected: editing main.tsx after A closes mid-task (ownership is temporal, not state-based — the governor's watch says A owns it through this task); rendering any Graph stub component (never-mounted bar); any dispatch/compat-gate consumption (live-seam task's).

(3) Never-mounted Graph must survive every surface addition — re-checked per step and in the flow test at every walk point. (4) Fixture-content tripwires fail the ROOT gate not the app gate — final greps.
